summary: References a Cache POP and outputs a weighted blend of cached POP data sets. It can blend indexed cached frames through sequential parameter blocks or CHOP channels.

key_params.name: cachepop
key_params.note: Cache POP to retrieve cached snapshots from

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: Optional CHOP for index and weight channels

key_params.name: indexchanunit
key_params.note: Unit of the CHOP-driven cache index channel

key_params.name: cache0index
key_params.note: Cache index for a blend block

key_params.name: cache0indexunit
key_params.note: Cache index unit for a blend block

key_params.name: cache0weight
key_params.note: Weight for a cache index block

key_concepts: References a Cache POP and blends multiple cached snapshots selected by cache-index blocks.
Each point is blended independently, making it useful for time blur, speed, or slope-like geometry trails.
Cache indices follow Cache POP history semantics: 0 is current and negative values move backward through cached data.
A CHOP can provide dynamic index and weight channels instead of fixed sequential block parameters.
common_gotchas: Cache indices are 0 and negative integers; 0 is current cached data and -1 is the previous cached data.
Interpolation only works when cached snapshots have compatible point counts.
Weights are normalized, which is useful for time blur but can surprise direct weighted-sum assumptions.
